name: proofloop-workspace
description: ProofLoop — one command runs everything (target-app + backend + built frontend)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix target-app install && npm --prefix proofloop install && npm --prefix proofloop/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix proofloop run build && npm --prefix proofloop/frontend run build
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run build && npm --prefix proofloop run start
scripts.dev: npm run setup && npm --prefix proofloop run dev
